allowed: metadata and results from completed non-Issue-110 investigations
public immutable external datasets collected independently of Issue #110
prohibited: Issue #110 acceptance, binding, or migration outcomes
blindness_boundary.pre_acquisition_inspection: Only repository topology, file names, JSON top-level keys, and frozen #110/#123 contracts were inspected before this freeze; no calibration observation values were extracted.

comparability.accept: Evidence must measure the same operational event under software-maintenance agent tasks, or supply a justified transport relation fixed without #110 outcomes.
reject: different unit or event with no transport argument
selected successes without all eligible attempts
comparability.population_target: independently sampled eligible repositories and non-study software-maintenance tasks executed by the intended #110 harness

conservative_bounds.binary_rates: Two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson interval; use the adverse endpoint (lower for acceptance, upper for censoring/attrition/environment failure).
conservative_bounds.correlation: Two-sided 95% Fisher-z interval when at least four independent paired units exist; otherwise unavailable.
conservative_bounds.variance_components: REML random-effects variance with a 95% profile-likelihood upper bound when at least five units at each relevant level exist; otherwise unavailable.
conservative_bounds.timing_variance: Unbiased sample variance and chi-square 95% upper confidence bound when comparable uncensored durations for at least five independent tasks exist; otherwise unavailable.
conservative_bounds.zero_events: Clopper-Pearson, not a zero point estimate.
conservative_bounds.selection_rule: No bound may be substituted or widened/narrowed in response to power favorability. Unavailable remains unavailable.

eligible_sources.rule: archived or published raw observations independent of Issue #110 with stable identity and adequate variable definitions
completed non-study tasks or operational dry runs fixed before any Issue #110 assignment and containing all eligible attempts

estimands.name: baseline acceptance rate
estimands.variable: binary acceptance among all comparable attempts

estimands.name: paired-condition correlation
estimands.variable: within-unit correlation of paired condition endpoint measurements

estimands.name: timing variance
estimands.variable: variance of uncensored end-to-end task duration

estimands.name: environment-failure rate
estimands.variable: environment-caused terminal failure among initiated executions

exclusions: synthetic or simulated observations except labeled sensitivity analysis
Issue #110 empirical outcomes in any blinded, pooled, or transformed form
AI agreement, test passage, or simulation as evidence for inferential assumptions
records lacking source identity or complete denominator
independent_adjudication: A reviewer not involved in extraction must verify source eligibility, hashes, calculation replay, blindness, and the two inferential-assumption assessments. Absence or non-independence of sign-off fails readiness.

inferential_assumptions.joint_central_sign_symmetry: Requires prospective domain evidence that, under the global null, the complete three-endpoint repository score vector has the same joint distribution as its negation; marginal symmetry is insufficient.
inferential_assumptions.repository_independence: Requires sampling-frame and provenance evidence excluding shared ancestry, contributors, infrastructure, duplicated tasks, and other cluster coupling for the intended repositories.
inferential_assumptions.rule: Evidence must precede #110 outcomes. Task-template randomization, simulations, synthetic data, passing tests, and AI agreement cannot establish either assumption. Failure cannot change the frozen inference model.

missing_data: Retain every missingness reason. Environment failures, attrition, and censoring are distinct indicators and are not silently dropped. Missing event classification makes the affected rate unavailable unless an adverse all-missing sensitivity bound is also reported.
post_observation_changes: Forbidden. Corrections require a numbered prospective amendment that may only govern newly acquired observations; this protocol continues to govern evidence acquired under it.
stopping_rule: Stop after exhausting repository-local completed non-study records and at most three named public-source acquisition attempts. Report NOT_READY immediately if any nuisance bound or either inferential assumption remains unsupported; do not seek favorable replacements after seeing estimates.
